# Fire and Radiation
## Fire
- Some fires spread, creeping across the floor to neighboring tiles for a while after they're lit. - Firefighter gear is stocked in the Tool Storage Machine.
### Extinguishers
- Use the extinguisher in your hand to take the safety off, then spray it at the fire. It reaches about 5 tiles. You can spray burning people to put them out. - The [bold]fire extinguisher[/bold] holds 50 units of water and clips onto your belt. The [bold]portable extinguisher[/bold] holds 30, but it's small enough to fit in a bag or pouch. - Refill an empty extinguisher from a water tank. - Extinguishers hang in wall cabinets around the colony and ship. A firefighting crate from requisitions comes with six.
### Fire Suppressant Grenades
- For fires too big to spray down. Throw one in and it snuffs out every fire in its area, including people who are burning. - It leaves cold inert gas behind, so the fire doesn't relight. - They're stocked in the Tool Storage Machine, and a firefighting crate comes with five.
## Radiation - Rad-shielded clothing cuts the radiation dose you take. A suit protects best with its matching shielded headgear. - Examine protective gear closely to see how much it shields.
